description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: Electron runtime launched successfully from the production build; BrowserWindow is 1200x800 with contextIsolation=true and nodeIntegration=false

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList renders a left library sidebar, empty state, document metadata, selection, and deletion; App loads persisted documents on mount

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: Right-side Q&A workspace submits through the typed preload bridge, restores persisted history, and renders citations and confidence

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: Runtime created C:/Users/12402/AppData/Roaming/knowledge-base/knowledge-base-data; PersistenceService atomically manages metadata, content, documents, chunks, index, and Q&A history
